title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Chandra's teacher and friend, who fights her to stop her killing the archaic and chooses to end the fight peacefully.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker, wounded and sick with migraines, who fights Ajani in order to kill the archaic before Jace can use it.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A Quandrix student who, in the climax, pushes Jadzi into the nexus and jumps in herself, saying she was made to do this.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A young Lorwyn elf student who, with the lumarets' help, finishes Jadzi's spell and calms the archaic.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A strong student who tries to break Fel's amber cage and rallies to follow Lluwen.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A student who tends Fel and the planeswalkers and notices reality is shifting around the archaic.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student who communicates by signing and by mind-speech and helps the group.

entities.name: Suki
entities.description: A Shattered student pyromancer who calls Chandra her teacher and charges to help.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: A Strixhaven professor who is trapped in amber while casting a spell at the archaic.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: An old oracle who tends the archaic and tries to calm it, until Tam pushes her into the nexus.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: Someone whose plan and mind Chandra feels pressing on her.

entities.name: The Giant Archaic
entities.description: A giant, wounded, eyeless being that howls and flings reality-warping spells in pain.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Small luminescent creatures that mirror Lluwen's movements and lend the power that completes the spell.

entities.name: The Nexus
entities.description: A whirling pit of magic that makes reality ripple and that Tam falls into.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: The bone-filled caverns on Arcavios where the fight and the crisis take place.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school whose version Tam sees in a vision, with Jadzi's office altered.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which the story takes place.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Lluwen's home plane, where elves live short lives.

events.summary: Ajani bats away a fireball with his axe as he and Chandra fight in the chamber.
events.quote: A fireball soared at him.

events.summary: Ajani catches Chandra's fist and hurls her into a bone wall, then finds he is proud when she stands up.
events.quote: he hurled her across the chamber.

events.summary: Tam leads the group's friends into the caverns, and Sanar smells burning.
events.quote: "Does anyone else smell burning?"

events.summary: Suki calls out that her teacher is in trouble and runs ahead, with Tam following.
events.quote: "Shatter Prime's in trouble."

events.summary: Chandra, dizzy, hurls a fireball at Ajani, who tanks another jet meant for the archaic.
events.quote: he was just in time to tank another jet of fire meant for the archaic.

events.summary: Ajani's axe bites Chandra's shoulder and she cauterizes the wound.
events.quote: Metal bit into her shoulder.

events.summary: Chandra drives a lance of fire into Ajani's thigh, and he tells her to stop hurting her friend.
events.quote: She drove a lance of fire into the leonin's thigh.

events.summary: The students feel reality tremble as they run toward the fight.
events.quote: Reality was a rippling tapestry being torn apart and rewoven right before their eyes.

events.summary: Ajani repeatedly throws Chandra away, and each time she gets back up.
events.quote: But every time he rebuffed her efforts, she got back up.

events.summary: Chandra heats Ajani's axe until he drops it, and pins him to the ground, ready to punch.
events.quote: The axe clattered to the ground between them.

events.summary: Ajani covers Chandra's hand and says they have been through enough; Chandra gives up and the battle is won.
events.quote: And he knew that—for whatever it was worth—the battle was won.

events.summary: The group is thrown through shifting environments as reality ripples around the archaic.
events.quote: Kirol spit up sea water.

events.summary: The students arrive to find Chandra and Ajani injured and leaning on one another.
events.quote: Next to her—with her arm slung across his shoulders like a wounded soldier—was Ajani Goldmane.

events.summary: A reality-wave freezes Chandra and Ajani mid-stride, and amber from the archaic's spell encases Fel.
events.quote: to thicken into amber around him, enveloping the professor before he could react.

events.summary: Jadzi tells the students to get to safety while she calms the archaic.
events.quote: I need to calm the archaic!"

events.summary: Tam pushes Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.
events.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.

events.summary: Tam tells her friends that she was made to do this and that they made her happy, then steps into the pit.
events.quote: "I was made to do this."

events.summary: The nexus snaps shut after Tam jumps in, leaving the friends shocked.
events.quote: Lluwen stared at the not-snarl as it snapped shut.

events.summary: Reality destabilizes and the air starts to fail; Suki is brought low.
events.quote: Reality wasn't stable around this panicking god-like being.

events.summary: Lluwen spots Jadzi's incomplete chain spell on the archaic and urges everyone to finish it.
events.quote: "Everyone! We have to finish the spell!"

events.summary: Lluwen's plea reaches Kirol, who throws Fel aside and rallies everyone to follow Lluwen.
events.quote: "All right!" they said. "Let's go! Everybody follow Lluwen!"

events.summary: Lluwen speaks to the archaic, and the lumarets mirror his movements, lending power to the spell.
events.quote: They were mirroring him.

events.summary: Gold light of unity encases the archaic and settles reality; Chandra and Ajani move again.
events.quote: They were encasing it.

events.summary: Fel, freed from the amber, credits Lluwen for soothing the archaic.
events.quote: young Lluwen has found a way to soothe it."

events.summary: In a place that is not quite Strixhaven, Tam stands over the sleeping Jadzi and is comforted by a man in white, who promises she will meet others like her.
events.quote: "You've found the others?" she asked him.

relations.note: Ajani thinks a teacher should never hurt a student in such a way.
relations.quote: A teacher should never hurt their student in this way.

relations.note: Suki sprints to help her teacher.
relations.quote: "Chandra!" she shouted. "We're here! Tell us what you need!"

relations.note: Lluwen calls Kirol his best friend.
relations.quote: "Who are you, and what have you done with my best friend?"

relations.note: Tam pushes Jadzi into the nexus.
relations.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.

relations.note: Jadzi tends to the archaic's wounds and tries to calm it.
relations.quote: The whole while she had been on the archaic's shoulder, tending to their wounds, whispering.
